data.body:
Change 1638 MERGED (submitted 2026-08-12 09:30:09 UTC). Gerrit rebased server-side, so the
landed sha is c9234694e0, not the pushed 926bddb42d. Worktree realigned onto the landed
commit and confirmed an ancestor of gerrit/main.

ACs verified ON THE LANDED TREE, not the pre-push tree:
- module-size cap: no src/rebar file over 800 (CI's exact command)
- env-var registry: gen_env_registry.py --check exit 0, REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY listed
- docs/concurrency.md carries the re-clone carry-over section and the override
- tests: 45 passed — 12 env-identity guard tests, the 29-test concurrency-regression suite
  (including the two-clone reconvergence test that drove the design correction), and the
  4 env-registry tests.

All 8 acceptance criteria ticked. Closing as class=preexisting: the mint-if-absent rule never
had a guard, so the silent re-identification was latent from the start rather than a break of
previously-working behaviour; ADR 0044's env-scoped attestations are what made it costly.

Out of scope and NOT done, per the operator decision: publishing per-environment op-cert
public keys into the store. That is the only form of 'accept multiple env ids' backed by a key
that can actually be checked, and it needs its own ADR.
